summary.text: V.L. Coffin, listed by Ballotpedia as VL Coffin, is a Republican member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windsor-2 District, which he has represented since January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he served in the U.S. Army.

sources.title: Vermont House of Representatives elections, 2026 - Ballotpedia
